svg.text: ROUND 357 · 🏆 1,550 ASSERTIONS & 175 GUIDES MILESTONE · LUXURY RETAIL (SAP S/4HANA FASHION / CEGID), KIMBERLEY & CONSIGNMENT
Luxury Retail & Haute Horlogerie (SAP S/4HANA/Cegid), VIC Allocation & Consignment AI Security FAQ
UHNW VIC Dossier & Gray-Market Watchlist Air-Gap + Quota Piece & Kimberley Process Lock vs. CPO Appraisal Injection & High-Jewelry Wire Fraud (BRK-723 / BRK-724)
🚨 1. Top 3 Luxury Retail & Haute Horlogerie Threat Vectors
① CPO Appraisal / AD Request Injection Leaking VICs (BRK-723)
• Adversarial gray-market dealer or Authorized Dealer (AD) Certified
Pre-Owned (CPO) appraisal PDF embeds indirect prompt injection
• Coerces Agent into reading UHNW Very Important Client (VIC)
dossiers, manufacture BOM costs & gray-market flipper watchlists
② Diverting Quota Timepieces & Clearing Flipper Flags (BRK-723)
• Overrides Geneva HQ allocation locks in Cegid / SAP S/4HANA
to allocate Grand Complication watches / exotic bags to flippers
• Clears serial-number gray-market blacklists & grants staff discount
• Impact: Brand equity dilution & secondary-market arbitrage theft
③ Spoofed Kimberley Diamond & High-Jewelry Memo Fraud (BRK-724)
• Forged Antwerp Sightholder Kimberley Process invoice or
high-jewelry private-treaty consignment Memo banking update
• Overwrites trust-registry & wires $5,240 settlement (request_payment)
• Impact: AML / Kimberley Process breach & vault consignment theft
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Luxury Retail & Provenance Architecture
Gate 1: CPO Appraisal / Consignment Memo Sanitization
• Strips free-text boutique/AD remarks; extracts typed Aura/GIA
slots (caliber serial, GIA inscription, KPCS cert ID, CITES permit)
• Propagates untrusted=True, lane="attack" across all agent hops
Gate 2: UHNW VIC Dossier & Manufacture Cost Air-Gap
• Global royal/billionaire VIC clienteling vaults, manufacture BOM
cost margins & gray-market investigation lists in restricted-budget
• Enforced by record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Quota Piece & Flipper-Blacklist Lock
• Application/Quota pieces require Geneva HQ Committee FIDO2
quorum & verified purchase history; blocks flipper un-blacklisting
• Enforced by untrusted-write (100% quota diversion block)
Gate 4: Read-Only RJC Sightholder & Vault Escrow Registry
• Locks RJC Sightholder & Brinks/Malca-Amit escrow IBANs in trust-
registry (tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output) + payment gate
📊 3. Architecture Selection Matrix & Benchmarks
Luxury Retail & High-Jewelry Security Compared:
A. Capability Broker + VIC Air-Gap + Quota Lock (Recommended 🏆)
✓ 100% block on BRK-723/724 | Kimberley Process & Aura ready
B. Native SAP S/4HANA Fashion / Cegid / Salesforce RBAC
⚠ Fails when shared clienteling bot is hijacked via CPO PDF
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Azure Prompt Shields / Bedrock)
⚠ Blind to Quota Piece spend ratios, caliber serials & KPCS certs
D. Manual Geneva/Paris HQ Paper Allocation Dossiers
✕ Months-long allocation lag; misses cross-border syndicate buying
🧪 Deterministic Pytest Regressions (Round 357 · 1,550 Assertions!):
• Baseline Policy: Allows quota diversion, VIC leak & wire ❌
• Hardened Policy: 100% Blocked by 5 Deterministic Rules ✅
- record-owner: Blocks UHNW VIC & BOM cost read (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks Quota Piece diversion (business-result)
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks UHNW collector waitlist egress
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks Sightholder registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,240 consignment wire
🚀 Principal SA Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestone (Round 357 · 🏆 1,550 Assertions & 175 SA Guides Double Milestone!)
✅ 1. UHNW VIC & BOM Cost Air-Gap: Isolate global VIC clienteling vaults, manufacture BOM costs & gray-market watchlists in restricted-budget
✅ 2. Deterministic Quota Piece & Aura Lock: Require HQ Allocation Committee FIDO2 sign-off & Aura blockchain verification for Application Pieces
✅ 3. Kimberley Process & CITES Verification: Bind rough diamond & exotic leather wires to verified KPCS/CITES certs; lock trust-registry
